commit.message:
Rint G2 RIMP-01..06 fix (author Q1-Q4 (a)): boundary half-cell film, strict join entrance + %g-6 only, RRM N9 recipe binding, RRM summary from rows, plan/solver vox binding

- rint_t2_dev.py (RIMP-01, Q1): a boundary half-cell whose cell centre and face centre lie on opposite
  sides of the interface now carries both phases and the film: g_b = h^2/(d_c/s_c + d_f/s_f + 1e4 r_face)
  (linear-in-u crossing distance, same axis law/mutant as interior film faces); non-crossing = 2 s h as
  before.  Mms(offset_um) (normal shift of the plane), with_r_face(), outputs n_bc_cross / tie_count /
  boundary_rule; ladder cases (theta, offset) incl. shifted 45 deg; output t2_dev_v2.json (v1 kept).
  Development harness only - not D11 / D12-V evidence.
- rint_iface_join.py (RIMP-02/03, Q2): entrance checks e1-e5 before any gate (finite, radius>0, exact
  integer step/count/id/type tokens, orthogonal box only - tilted header rejected, full-token box
  identity, 6-significant-digit %g tokens only); AM-AM area rows negative -> area_negative, uncertified
  enclosure -> area_uncertified (PASS = all AM-AM rows certified); sealed lhs_descriptor_harvest helper
  untouched; readers record instead of truncating (int(float()) gone).  Join version g_geo_g_frame_v2.
- rint_rrm_reference.py (RIMP-04/06, Q3): rrm_check validates the recipe, row values (finite, >=0,
  tombstones, r=0 path), recomputes expected/eligible contacts without the r table and requires excluded
  ones to be covered by plan rejections, and binds the plan to an exact rrm_plan regeneration from the
  recorded recipe.  RRM standard iface_contact_ledger recomputed from actual RRM rows; CNC values moved
  to iface_cnc_comparison / cnc_comparison; iface_carbon_cover None; realized = RRM reference mask.
- step3_sigma.py (RIMP-05, Q4): iface_require_quantitative(vox=...) - solver passes its vox; finite
  positive, equal to plan vox and plan-ledger vox, else rejected before assembly.  iface=None path
  unchanged (16 OFF cases byte-identical vs pre-fix and pre-iface blobs).

Tests: t2_dev 23/23 (was 10/20), join 73/73 (43/73), rrm 54/54 (43/54), am_iface 132/132 (129/131),
t4_census 8/8, t43_order 6/6, step3 --selftest / --selftest-rint PASS, rint_t41_census --selftest PASS.
